Class Employee

java.lang.Object
edu.tamu.project2.csce331.Employee
public class Employee extends Object
Represents an employee with an ID, name, role, pay, and status. Valid roles are "cashier" and "manager". This class provides getters and setters for each field with validation.
Author:
Daniel Zhang

  • Constructor Details

    • Employee

      public Employee(int id, String name, String role, double pay, boolean state) throws IllegalArgumentException
      Constructs an Employee object with the specified id, name, role, pay, and status.
      Parameters:
      id - the employee's ID, must be non-negative
      name - the employee's name
      role - the employee's role, must be one of the valid roles
      pay - the employee's pay, must be non-negative
      state - the employee's status (active or inactive)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if id or pay is negative, or if role is invalid
